comment: Gameplay mix capture for the loudness gate (docs/plans/fun-craft-targets.md row 19). A joined human runs and fires at a live rule bot on Larak Lot for 15 seconds with the radio on its default station; the Master bus is recorded after its limiter (pre master fader) and measured with `cargo run -p localexception-audiogen -- loudness --check <out>/NN_live_audio.wav`. Run with LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_BOTS=1, LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_NO_ROUND_EVENTS=1 and LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/mix-loudness.json on a real audio driver (not Dummy).

states.name: mix_fight
states.note: Running, strafing fire against a live bot: own and enemy weapons, hits, footsteps, landings, Host and the radio under combat ducking.
